_about: Accepted player photos (orchestrator-curated from Wikimedia Commons lead images of the players' English Wikipedia articles). Each: Commons file, licence (allowed: CC0, Public domain, CC BY / CC BY-SA with version, Attribution), licence URL, photographer (artist), Commons page (source), thumbnail size [w,h], and the largest Vision face box [x,y,w,h] normalised with origin bottom-left, clamped to the image. Auto-accepted only when the largest face is >= 1.5% of the image and >= 2x any other face, with a named artist; photo-exclusions.json removes reviewed rejects.
